convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to call external indicator 'XCCI_Histogram_Vol' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Requires the custom .ex5 indicator file for signal generation, making auto-conversion impossible without replicating the custom indicator logic.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one in reverse direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMFix negative value=fixed lots (abs value); positive value=fraction of deposit per 1000 units; zero=auto based on margin

custom_logic_notes: Uses Exp_Trailing and Exp_Trailing3 custom trailing stop modules from include files. Position sizing has 3 modes: fixed lots (negative MMFix), deposit fraction (positive MMFix, fraction per 1000 currency units), and margin-based auto (MMFix=0). Opposite signal triggers close of current position then opens new position in reverse direction. Signal evaluated on completed bar (bar [1] and [2]) not current bar. XCCI_Histogram_Vol is a composite CCI-based indicator with volume multiplier that must be available as .ex5 custom indicator.
python_conversion_notes: The XCCI_Histogram_Vol custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. It uses a CCI calculation with an extended/smoothing period (XCCI_period) and a volume multiplier (Vol_multiplier). The EA reads two buffers: buffer 0 (histogram) and buffer 1 (trend line). Entry requires both buffers to agree on direction (both above 0 for long, both below 0 for short). The position sizing conditional logic (MMFix sign-based mode switching) must be carefully translated. Trailing stop modules from .mqh includes need to be reimplemented. Digit adjustment (PriceLevelUt) is critical for SL/TP calculation and must replicate the 5-digit/3-digit broker adjustment logic.
